articles.headline: Enterprise spending slows in second half as software and services demand cools
articles.summary: Survey data points to slower enterprise technology spending in the second half of 2026, with traditional software and services showing weakness. That is relevant for business leaders weighing renewal budgets, vendor consolidation, and discretionary IT projects.

articles.headline: UK data watchdog warns Met Police over shadow IT data breach
articles.summary: A regulator warned about an ongoing failure to restrict staff from using unauthorized IT services, underscoring how shadow IT can create compliance and security exposure. Businesses should see this as a reminder to tighten governance over unsanctioned tools and data handling.

articles.headline: AI race puts $3.5 trillion at write-down risk, Gartner warns
articles.summary: Gartner warns that a large share of AI infrastructure spending could be impaired by 2030 if revenues fail to catch up with capital outlays. For businesses, this signals potential pressure on cloud pricing, AI vendor economics, and the pace of future infrastructure investment.
